errors.evidence: The description states that the unit of the y-axis is percentage ("单位为百分比"), but the chart does not provide any unit for the y-axis. The values, which go up to approximately 147, make percentage an unlikely unit.
The description uses the evaluative term "显著高于" (significantly higher) to compare the two categories of bars. The prompt instructs to use neutral language and avoid subjective or evaluative terms.
